name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-mario
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Mario
description:
Due to the recent Nintendo leaks I took it
upon myself to rip the original from original files,
and so here we are. Some sprites were missing so
I had to use a few sprites from Yoshi Master.
To make the palette i used MM102's Character Kit
specifically the palette patcher.
I have also used a custom mini mario ducking from
smm2.
The zip includes:
* The palette patch (optional)
* A shared palette file
* GFX32, GFX00 and GFX22 for mario sprites

Credits:
MM102
Yoshi Master
Please check them out, these are great people, without them this wouldn't happen.
